review_text: Despite having a lot of orders coming in, the staff stayed calm, friendly, and genuinely accommodating the whole time. You could see they were busy, but they never made customers feel rushed or ignored. Service like that really makes the experience better. Great coffee is one thing, but great people behind the counter make you want to keep coming back.

Although this Pickup Coffee is pinned in the Condotel Sherwood Centro Spacial Condos on Google Maps, that is not where it is. It’s on the main floor of Felcris Centrale. I ordered the Iced Sea Salt Latte to take home. I’ve never had issues with Pickup Coffee and although it was sweeter than I like, it was still enjoyable. You have a few options for coffee in this mall so everyone should be able to find something they like.
